      isWholeLine: true,
      rangeBehavior: 1,
      gutterIconPath: icon,
      overviewRulerColor:
        grayMode ? (path === 'resolution-error' ? ScrollColor.Error : ScrollColor.Unknown)
          : path.startsWith('error-range')
            ? ScrollColor.ErrorRange
            : path.startsWith('error')
              ? ScrollColor.Error
              : path.startsWith('verified')
                ? ScrollColor.Verified
                : ScrollColor.Unknown
    })
